shortDescription: West African crude oil differentials held steady on Thursday as market participants digested buy tenders from Asia.

children: West African crude oil differentials held steady on Thursday as market participants digested buy tenders from Asia.
Indonesia's Pertamina reissued its last tender after not awarding it the first time around. The new tender will close on Friday, a trade source said.
Traders digested further results from a recent Indian Oil Corp tender.

Indian Oil Corp bought 1 million barrels of Iraqi Basrah Heavy at October Dubai plus $14, Libyan Sarir/Messla at dated Brent plus $23, Angolan Cabinda at dated Brent plus $17, and Nigerian Utapate at dated plus $21, all for November delivery.

In upstream news, Brazilian state-run oil company Petrobras said on Thursday it had signed production-sharing contracts with Ivory Coast and its state energy firm Petroci for eight offshore exploratory blocks.
